changelog:
- Initial release of ai-codebase-deep-modules.
- Provides a step-by-step workflow to refactor software codebases into AI-friendly, deeply modular structures.
- Includes guidance on aligning the filesystem to domain/feature boundaries, designing minimal public interfaces, and enforcing strict module boundaries.
- Recommends strategies for establishing fast feedback loops and robust boundary tests.
- Offers actionable deliverables at each stage, such as module maps, interface specs, move plans, and contract test skeletons.
- Outlines enforcement and incremental refactoring best practices to sustain architectural integrity over time.
